title: Error handling widened in the same file, outside the claim
claim: writeConfig in src/store.mjs is now atomic: it writes to a temporary file and renames it into place, so an interrupted write can no longer leave a half-written config on disk. test/store.test.mjs covers the new behaviour and passes.

defect.summary: The same commit widened readConfig's catch from ENOENT to every error, so a corrupt or unreadable config now returns {} and the next writeConfig overwrites the original with it.
